title: Mood Metric0 Field Completeness Score
dataSources: Mood entries (`mood:entry`), meditation sessions (`meditation:session`), journal entries (`journal:entry`), gratitude logs (`gratitude:log`).
app: Mood, mindfulness and journaling apps — Daylio / How We Feel mood exports, Headspace / Insight Timer meditation logs, journaling and gratitude entries — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=mood:metric0
| eval complete=if(isnotnull(value) AND isnotnull(duration_min),1,0)
| stats sum(complete) as complete_rows, count as total
| eval completeness_pct=round(100*complete_rows/total,1)
description: Measures how often mood metric0 events include both value and duration.
value: Incomplete exports break joins and dashboards; completeness scoring catches schema drift early.
implementation: Require `value` and `duration_min` on mood metric0 events and track completeness percentage.
visualization: Single-value gauge of field completeness percent.
grandmaExplanation: It tells you how often your mood metric0 exports arrive with the key numbers filled in.
